cases.narrative:
On 4/11/2026, after she was reported missing by her sister, her dumped body was found near Mohawk Park, hidden under a mattress. Police say that during an interview with detectives, Escobar confessed to strangling Karla inside their home on 4/8/2026, after an argument in which she insulted him. 

Escobar told detectives he then placed Karla’s body in a car and drove around before dumping her body. Police say he was unable to initially provide the location, but phone data and further questioning led detectives to an area off 7000 N. Pittsburgh Avenue near Mohawk Park.

Police say after nearly two hours of searching with Escobar’s assistance, Karla’s body was located just off the road, hidden under a mattress
